essence: One should offer milk-rice into the golden seed after worship.
The prescribed yantra consists of a circle, triangle, hexagon, and eight petals.
One should worship the deer-lord tearing apart the buffalo in the northeast corner.
One should worship Śākambharī, Durgā, Bhīmā, and Bhrāmarī.
The mantras for all powers are their names.
